content: [GitHub psf/requests PR#6963 comment awoimbee Mon Mar 04 12:00 UTC 2026] This PR fixes CVE-2024-47081 by parsing the URL more carefully and stripping userinfo from netloc before passing to netrc. The key commit is 5b4b64c3467fd7a3c03f91ee641aaa348b6bed3b.
